keySentence: She was tiny — no bigger than a thumb.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Thumbelina played with butterflies. She was very very tiny. She dreamed of adventure. She was tiny, no bigger than a thumb.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Thumbelina spent happy days playing with butterflies. She washed her face with morning dew drops. She was tiny, no bigger than a thumb in the garden. At night, she wondered if there were others like her. She dreamed of exploring the wide, beautiful world. Soon, an unexpected adventure would find the tiny girl.
